author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for The Funnel, a 2.5D puzzle exploration game developed by Bronzeman Studio. Players will engage with mixing branching dialogue and puzzle minigames to make sense of an abstract world. The Funnel is available now for PC (Steam).
title: The Funnel - Official Launch Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for The 7th Shift, a psychological horror game developed by Dookos Games. Players will work the overnight shift at a lonely grocery store. Stock shelves, clean the store, and face sinister forces that could point to the reasoning they were hired in the first place. The 7th Shift is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The 7th Shift - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Night Hike, a single-player puzzle roguelike game developed by Michael Neumann. Players will choose their own path across a sinister forest to search for a way out. Reach escape from the endless night in Night Hike, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Night Hike - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Rabbit's Tale, a 2D action platformer Metroidvania developed by Golden Bug Studios. Players will explore the purple Void as a Rabbit in search of his kidnapped family. Overcome platforming obstacles, engage in intense combat, and explore a vibrant world. Rabbit's Tale is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Rabbit's Tale - Official Announcement Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Official Trailer for Do Not Buy This Game, a comedic mystery decision-making game developed by Kingblade Games. Players will hear a narration of a man pleading not to buy this game by any means necessary. Do Not Buy This Game is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Do Not Buy This Game - Official Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Sakura DLC Launch Trailer for House Flipper 2, a sandbox cleaning management game developed by Frozen District. Players can now access the new Sakura DLC, packed with five new jobs, over 600 Japan-themed items, and five new houses to purchase. The Sakura DLC for House Flipper 2 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: House Flipper 2 - Official Sakura DLC Launch Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Teaser Trailer for Dreampainters, a first-person action puzzle game developed by Stability Games. Players will enter an artist's dream to discover mysteries through painting. Solve puzzles alone or with friends in Dreampainters, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Dreampainters - Official Reveal Teaser Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Early Access Launch Trailer for House of Legacy, a political management sandbox game developed by S3 Studio. Players will raise a healthy clan through planning, trading, and diplomacy to create a timeless dynasty. House of Legacy is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: House of Legacy - Official Early Access Launch Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Crossplay Trailer for Stuffed, a first-person shooter developed by Waving Bear Studio. Players will defend their owner from waves of nightmares with an arsenal of weapons, alone or in 4-player co-op. Stuffed is available now for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam), with crossplay implementation.
title: Stuffed - Official Crossplay Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World, a 2D sci-fi gothic Metroidvania developed by Vertex Zero. Players will fight through a gothic sci-fi world to make sense of the biological organisms made by a long-gone civilization. Master the game's melee-based action combat, discover forbidden secrets, and navigate a sprawling map with much to explore. Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC (Steam).
title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Window Trailer for Lost in Tandem, a 2D puzzle platforming adventure game developed by Tempete Studio. Players will embark on a vast mission to solve puzzles, explore vibrant locations, and aid a young girl and a defective robot called "Mech-ute" across a post-apocalyptic world. Lost in Tandem is launching in July 2026 for PC (Steam).
title: Lost in Tandem - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Calame, a narrative-driven tactical RPG developed by Nextale Games. Players will head into the trials and tribulations of war to lead through decision-making. Alter the course of battle through turn-based combat in Calame, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC.
title: Calame - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for MLB The Show Mobile, a free-to-play mobile iteration of the hit baseball simulation game developed by Sony San Diego Studio. Players will take America's pastime on the go to take bases, build a deck of authentic MLB players and legends, and more. MLB The Show Mobile is available now on iOS and Android.
title: MLB The Show Mobile - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Season 2 Developer Overview for Marathon, the hit first-person sci-fi extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players will get the rundown on the new additions with Season 2: Nightfall straight from the development team with the new Night Marsh map, Sentinel Runner shell, weapons, and more. A free weekend is also coming to Marathon from June 2 through June 9. Get a look at gameplay of Night Marsh and Sentinel with the latest Developer Overview for Season 2 of Marathon, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marathon - Official Season 2 Developer Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Midnight Moments announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy cyberpunk diorama-building game where you build rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, and quiet neighbourhood corners, then zoom in and fill them with handcrafted props and citizens. No goals, no pressure, just vibes. Midnight Moments will be available on PC. You can wishlist Midnight Moments on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4666090/Midnight_Moments/
title: Midnight Moments - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the 4K DLSS 4.5 Gameplay for 007 First Light, the latest third-person action-adventure game based on the beloved 007 IP developed by IO Interactive. Players will experience the younger years of James Bond in stunning fidelity courtesy of NVIDIA technology with DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation and Super Resolution support. 007 First Light is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: 007 First Light - Official 4K DLSS 4.5 Gameplay

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Reveal Trailer for Stolen Realm Survivors, an action bullet hell roguelike developed by Burst2Flame Games. Players will take on hordes of enemies, acquire artifacts and skills, and take on an unforgiving realm alone or with friends in co-op. Stolen Realm Survivors is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Stolen Realm Survivors - Official Reveal Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Early Access Gameplay Trailer for Pizza Bandit, a third-person action PvE shooter developed by Jofsoft. Players will build a pizza business all while defending their lives against waves of enemies. Manage stamina, complete orders, and upgrade equipment to take on incoming hordes. Pizza Bandit is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Pizza Bandit - Official Early Access Gameplay Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Overview Trailer for Everdream Village, a cozy adventure farming simulation game developed by Mooneaters. Players will tend to crops, meet fellow villagers, and establish a serene place to unwind and relax. Everdream Village is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam).
title: Everdream Village - Official Overview Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Shelf Heroes, a first-person action roguelite shooter developed by Fun Punch Games. Players will take on waves of toys as a Shelf Hero with a variety of weapons to make use of, perk combos to exploit, and a massive house to explore alone or with friends in co-op. Shelf Heroes is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Shelf Heroes - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Gameplay Trailer for World of Tanks: HEAT, a free-to-play tank hero shooter developed by Wargaming Group. Players will turn up the heat on the battlefield with three different Agents and Tanks, four game modes, eight maps, and more to unlock new ways to dominate any combat engagement. World of Tanks: HEAT is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: World of Tanks: HEAT - Official Launch Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the C-Beams announcement trailer for this upcoming sci-fi action RPG. Pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system in C-Beams. Engage in advanced ship combat, haul rare elements, and upgrade your vessel to survive. Stunning visuals, a deep narrative, and a rewarding progression system await as you uncover the abyss's dark secrets. C-Beams will be available on PC (Epic Games Store and Steam).
title: C-Beams - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Technical Behind-the-Scenes Video for Tides of Annihilation, an upcoming fantasy action-adventure game developed by Eclipse Glow Games. Players can hear from the development team behind the game's deep technical partnership between Unreal Engine and NVIDIA. Said partnership is intended to deliver unmatched visual fidelity and next-gen gaming performance to keep up with the action of Tides of Annihilation. Path tracing, super resolution, detailed facial animations, and more are coming to Tides of Annihilation, launching soon on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Tides of Annihilation - Official Technical Behind-the-Scenes Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss 'The Swarm' Update Trailer for No Man's Sky, the hit action-adventure exploration shooter developed by Hello Games. Players can get a look at the latest upcoming update, fitted with a menacing threat that stalks planets from the skies above. Partake in epic space battles as players branch off into three factions to cooperate, strategize, and compete to take on the Hive of Glass, an existential threat to the universe itself. Save the universe in 'The Swarm' Update, launching on May 27 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, macOS, and PC (Steam).
title: No Man's Sky - Official 'The Swarm' Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Taming Gameplay Trailer for Under a Rock, an open-world survival and creature taming game developed by Nordic Trolls. Players will set out into procedurally generated worlds to survive, overcome challenges, and tame wild creatures. Bring them back to base to produce resources and eventually hatch them into companions that can be ridden, fight, and evolve over time. Under a Rock is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Under a Rock - Official Taming Gameplay Trailer
